title: 第一卷 第30章 油腻咋了？  有用就行
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
李华嘿嘿一笑：“乖。”

    他承认，这的确有些油腻。

    但俗话又说回来，甭管黑猫白猫，能抓老鼠的都是好猫。

    对付女人的手段也是一样。

    油腻咋了？

    有用就行。

    看着张春妮被他的威势震慑，乖乖巧巧的样子。

    他突然有一些担心。

    张春妮这个性格太软，容易被人拿捏欺负了。

    他得牢牢的攥手里才行啊。

    鸡蛋是土鸡蛋。

    他们这边的鸡鸭都是在海边滩涂自己跑，自己找吃的东西。

    吃的比较杂，还吃海鲜。

    所以他们这边的鸡蛋、鸭蛋，在后世还成了特色农产品。

    有没有什么特别的营养？不知道，但的确是很好吃。

    而且鸡蛋比较小。

    对于李华来说，一口就是一个张春妮的嘴巴与牙小，几口也就吃掉了。

    李华又剥了一个。

    张春妮还在咀嚼鸡蛋，小腮帮鼓鼓的，赶紧摇头，含糊不清地说道：“我……我不吃了。”

    李华说道：“这是我打算剥给自己吃的，既然你说不吃，那这个鸡蛋就给你。”

    张春妮：“啊？”

    李华说道：“我看过一本书上说，女孩子说不要就是要的意思。”

    张春妮：“才没有。”

    李华：“哦，懂了，那就是有。”

    李华一脸无奈的说道：“我剥都剥好了，吃吧。”

    张春妮的脸颊红的跟桃花一样，说道：“我……我自己来。”

    接过鸡蛋，低着头，跟个仓鼠一样，小口小口地吃了起来。

    李华满意地笑了。

    看看。

    一个驴一个拴法，这话说起来糙，但一点没毛病。

    剩下的鸡蛋，他和阿青一人一半，还把张春妮带来的早饭也是吃得干干净净。

    他问道：“吃饱了吗？”

    张春妮连忙点点头：“饱了。”

    李华把篮子收好，说道：“太好吃了，不够吃的。”

    张春妮：“那我下次多做点。”

    李华点点头。

    他起身收拾，饱嗝是一个接着一个。

    噎到了。
content_en:
Li Hua chuckled: "Be good."

    He admitted that it was a bit greasy.

    But as the saying goes, it doesn’t matter whether the cat is black or white, any cat that can catch mice is a good cat.

    The same goes for dealing with women.

    What's wrong with the greasiness?

    Just be useful.

    Seeing Zhang Chunni being frightened by his power and acting obediently.

    He suddenly felt worried.

    Zhang Chunni's character is too soft and she is easily manipulated and bullied.

    He has to hold it firmly in his hand.

    The eggs are free-range eggs.

    The chickens and ducks here all run around on the beach and look for food by themselves.

    The food is quite varied, including seafood.

    Therefore, their eggs and duck eggs became specialty agricultural products in later generations.

    Are there any special nutrients? I don’t know, but it’s really delicious.

    And the eggs are smaller.

    For Li Hua, one bite is as big as Zhang Chunni's mouth and small teeth, and he can eat it in just a few bites.

    Li Hua peeled off another one.

    Zhang Chunni was still chewing the eggs, her cheeks bulging, she quickly shook her head and said vaguely: "I...I won't eat it."

    Li Hua said: "I plan to peel this for myself. Since you said you don't want to eat it, I will give you this egg."

    Zhang Chunni: "Huh?"

    Li Hua said: "I read a book that said that when a girl says she doesn't want something, she means she wants it."

    Zhang Chunni: "No."

    Li Hua: "Oh, I understand, that's right."

    Li Hua said with a helpless look: "I've peeled it off, let's eat it."

    Zhang Chunni's cheeks were as red as peach blossoms and she said, "I...I will do it myself."

    He took the egg, lowered his head, and ate it in small bites like a hamster.

    Li Hua smiled with satisfaction.

    have a look.

    It sounds rough to say that one donkey is tied to another, but there is nothing wrong with it.

    He and Ah Qing each shared half of the remaining eggs, and they also ate the breakfast brought by Zhang Chunni.

    He asked: "Are you full?"

    Zhang Chuni nodded quickly: "I'm full."

    Li Hua put the basket away and said, "It's so delicious, there's not enough to eat."

    Zhang Chuni: "Then I will do more next time."

    Li Hua nodded.

    He got up to clean up, and the burps came one after another.

    Choked.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 30 What’s wrong with greasiness?  Just be useful
